appInfo.name: CIRA Education Fleet Platform
appInfo.institution: CIRA Education (Serving BUC, BUA & Futures Schools)

contact.location: CIRA Education HQ · Central Fleet Operations Command

roleDescriptions.Requester: Staff and faculty who need university vehicles: calculate fuel costs upfront, submit bookings, and track live trips.
roleDescriptions.Dispatcher: Central desk approving vehicle requests, preventing schedule overlaps, assigning certified drivers, and triaging incidents.
roleDescriptions.Driver: Mobile dashboard for shift check-ins, circle inspections, step-by-step waypoint navigation, SOS reporting, and fuel receipt closeouts.
roleDescriptions.Fleet admin: Fleet governance: vehicle asset registry, maintenance lockouts, fuel price book versions, quota limits, and performance KPIs.
roleDescriptions.Auditor: Read-only financial audit trails, fuel variance anomaly detection, tamper-proof logs, and department cost-center chargeback reports.

steps.title: Landing page
steps.say: Public entrance presenting fleet capabilities, university policies, and single sign-on access.
tries: Click "Sign in" or browse "Who it's for"

steps.title: One sign-in, five roles
steps.say: Staff sign in with their university account; permissions decide their view and accessible actions.
tries: Pick any role badge under "Demo · Sign in as" to enter

steps.title: Requester home
steps.say: Department fuel quota at a glance, pending approvals, and active trip tracking shortcut.

steps.title: Find the right vehicle
steps.say: Browse university fleet by vehicle type, seats, payload, fuel type, and accessibility.
tries: Click "Book this vehicle" on Hyundai H-1

steps.title: Book with cost known
steps.say: Calculate trip distance, fuel consumption, and EGP cost upfront with machine-learning accuracy.

steps.title: Dispatch desk
steps.say: Central triage hub: schedule clashes, maintenance lockouts, and pending trip requests.

steps.title: Approve without double-booking
steps.say: Requested V-114 has a 45-min buffer conflict; swap to available V-122 and verify driver eligibility.

steps.title: Timeline & Gantt schedule
steps.say: Visual timeline showing booked trips, cleaning/prep buffers, and maintenance lockouts.
tries: Click the red clash block on V-114

steps.title: Driver home
steps.say: Assigned vehicle, next pickup waypoint, duty hours countdown, and pre-trip checklist status.

steps.title: Shift and duty limits
steps.say: Clock-in verification, 5-point safety inspection, and 8-hour maximum driving safety bar.

steps.title: Active trip manifest
steps.say: Stop-by-stop waypoints, passenger manifests, dispatch notes, and offline data sync indicator.

steps.title: Live run & navigation
steps.say: Turn-by-turn simulation, live GPS speed, telemetry signal quality, and emergency SOS button.

steps.title: Requester live tracker
steps.say: Trip requester follows their assigned vehicle in real-time with strict privacy safeguards.
tries: Watch vehicle progress along the Obour-Ramadan corridor

steps.title: Telemetry hub & fleet map
steps.say: Live GPS telemetry for all university vehicles with speed, fuel level, and status filters.

steps.title: Incident triage & emergency
steps.say: Photo damage inspection, passenger safety verification, tow truck dispatch, and replacement vehicle.

steps.title: Notification center
steps.say: Role-filtered alert feed: safety warnings, schedule change alerts, and automated shift reminders.

steps.title: Close trip with proof
steps.say: Return odometer entry, fuel litres purchased, receipt photo attachment, and circle check.

steps.title: My bookings list
steps.say: History of university vehicle bookings with status badges and estimated vs. actual fuel reconciliation.

steps.title: Booking detail & audit
steps.say: 6-stage lifecycle stepper, assigned vehicle specs, locked cost estimate, and dispatch chat log.
tries: Send a message to dispatch desk

steps.title: Fleet admin dashboard
steps.say: Overall fleet utilization rate, maintenance compliance, fuel price updates, and department quotas.

steps.title: Vehicles & price book
steps.say: Vehicle asset details, scheduled preventive maintenance, historical fuel price book, and department budgets.
tries: Switch tabs: Maintenance, Price book, Quotas

steps.title: Drivers & license governance
steps.say: Driver license expiration monitoring, permitted vehicle classes, and license renewal upload.

steps.title: Fleet KPI analytics
steps.say: Operational intelligence: vehicle utilization, dispatch approval velocity, fuel accuracy, and uptime.

steps.title: Auditor dashboard
steps.say: Internal audit overview: financial fuel variance anomalies, pending reconciliations, and chargebacks.

steps.title: Audit reconciliation & export
steps.say: Tamper-proof event log, trip fuel variance analysis with anomaly detection, and department chargeback export.
